title: A Darboux-Theorem-Based Derivation of Geometric Structures in Various Non-Abelian Gauge Theories
summary: This paper illustrates the straightforward application of the Faddeev--Jackiw approach to several non-Abelian gauge theories, namely, the Freedman--Townsend, Yang--Mills, and non-Abelian BF models, as well as a nonlinear theory of BF type. For each theory, the procedure determines the phase space and its symplectic structure, the coisotropic constraint submanifold, the Hamiltonian, and the reducibility properties of the constraints.
